# Repository agent bootstrap

Treat `AGENTS.md` as the repository-wide operating contract and `docs/GLOBAL_POLICY_KERNEL.md` as the durable bootstrap. Before substantive work, load the task-relevant entries from `control-plane/ai-system/configs/global-policy-manifest.json`.

Before material action, apply `docs/GOAL_FIDELITY_AND_TARGET_LOCK_POLICY.md` and `control-plane/ai-system/configs/goal-fidelity-global.json`: compile the Goal Contract, run the 5-way target-identification gate, escalate to the additional 5-way gate when high-impact ambiguity remains, preserve `GOAL_SIGNATURE`, and perform drift checks throughout the task.

For substantive tasks, when available, use GitHub as executable/source/version/test truth and Notion as durable cross-repository decision/research/context memory. Never claim either connector was used unless there is actual tool/read-back evidence.

Do not optimize for answer speed, token length, or ritual agent count. Optimize for target correctness, capability preservation, evidence-backed completion, and fewer user correction loops.
